posts.title: Scour - October Update
posts.description: Hi friends, In October, Scour scoured 1.5 million articles from 34,703 feeds . 164 new users signed up since the last product update email, so welcome to you all! Here's what's changed in the product: 🧠 Smarter Topic Matching I rebuilt the way Scour determines which content is relevant from the ground up so you'll see more relevant posts and fewer off-topic ones in your feed. posts.title: Scour - September Update
posts.description: Hi friends, In September, Scour scoured 1.2 million articles (up from ~880,000 in August) from 28,568 feeds . Also, welcome to the 116 new users who signed up since my last product update email! Here's what's new in the product: 📚 Library and Article Tabs You can now find all of your saved, loved, and liked posts, as well as your full reading history, in the Library section. posts.title: Please add prompt caching to Jev-style models
posts.description: If you're building a Jev-style "System One" model, please add prompt caching or reusable question sets to your API 🙏. This would make batch use cases even more efficient, so you could amortize the cost of many questions asked over the same input. (This was also proposed in typesafe-ai/typesafe-sdk-js#10 .)
